definitions.explanation: The designated place where passengers board trains, buses, or taxis.

examples.japanese: バスの{乗|の}り{場|ば}はどこですか。
タクシー{乗|の}り{場|ば}は{駅|えき}の{前|まえ}にあります。
examples.english: The taxi stand is in front of the station.

examples.japanese: 5{番|ばん}{乗|の}り{場|ば}から{電車|でんしゃ}が{出|で}ます。

notes: {乗|の}り{場|ば} combines {乗|の}る (to ride) and {場|ば} (place). It's used for various transportation: バス{乗|の}り{場|ば} (bus stop), タクシー{乗|の}り{場|ば} (taxi stand), {電車|でんしゃ}{乗|の}り{場|ば} (train platform). At train stations, platforms are numbered (1{番|ばん}{乗|の}り{場|ば}, 2{番|ばん}{乗|の}り{場|ば}).
